consequence.statement: After upgrading to v1.0.0, Karpenter scheduling no longer intermittently flakes due to nodepool readiness; environments that experienced the flake see it resolved.
consequence.remediation: None required; the fix ships with the upgrade.

original.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 fixes an intermittent scheduling flake caused by nodepool readiness handling (PR #6491), changing scheduling behavior with no configuration change on the operator side.

consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the change touches only the E2E scheduling test suite (test/suites/scheduling/suite_test.go), and Karpenter's runtime behavior does not change.

corrected.statement: PR #6491 fixes a flaky E2E scheduling test in which a test NodePool did not set its NodeClass group and so could stay unready. Only test/suites/scheduling/suite_test.go changed, so operators see no consequence.

decision.reason: The linked PR and commit change only one file, test/suites/scheduling/suite_test.go [ev-b889081063a3] [ev-28bbf8a48e60]. The PR description says the flake came from a test NodePool that did not set the NodeClass group, so readiness was never re-reconciled [ev-f0215a9bf24c]. That makes this a fix to an E2E test flake, not a change to how Karpenter behaves at runtime. The proposed behavior-change, which says customer scheduling no longer flakes, is not supported. The consequence is none, and the class is informational, not review.
